steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin tree trunks and limbs
steps.load: liner loaded with gesso

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: daub clumps of gesso for leaf areas
steps.load: gesso dabbed on a paper towel

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: make small stone shapes at the bottom
steps.load: gesso loaded on the filbert

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: glaze blue over the whole background
steps.load: small amount on the brush
steps.rule: the clear makes the color act as a glaze

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: pull a brown streak for the back rock
steps.load: brown mix pulled flat on the knife

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: mix gray marbled rock and gently touch it on
steps.load: gray mix left marbled on the knife
steps.rule: leave the mix marbled so streaks transfer to canvas

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: pull the water stroke down the rock
steps.load: blue and white thinned with clear
steps.where: over the rock down to the base

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap soft mist at the base of the waterfall
steps.load: small amount of the water color
steps.rule: the soft blender lets you paint over the layer

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: pull brown into a rock that contains the waterfall
steps.load: roll of brown on the knife edge
steps.motion: drag down and fade into the mist
steps.rule: a rock here keeps the waterfall contained

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint a flat top on the rock
steps.load: same brown mix

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: blend mist out past the rock
steps.load: small amount of mist color

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: block in dark green bush shapes
steps.load: both sides loaded and tapped
steps.motion: tap basic bush shapes, including the corner
steps.rule: dark base gives highlights something to show against

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap a big bush on the right side over the top
steps.load: same dark mix
steps.motion: tap and let it hang over

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pick out individual yellow highlights
steps.load: pull through paint and tap to form a ridge
steps.rule: one highlight at a time keeps the dark from being covered

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap a hanging bush over the lower edge
steps.load: thinner added, more sap green and yellow

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: dab small highlights in red and yellow
steps.load: same brush with yellow and red

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: paint the bush on the other side in yellow ochre
steps.load: yellow ochre added to the bush mix

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: overlap a bush arm in front of the waterfall
steps.load: same brush
steps.rule: overlap pushes the waterfall back so it looks farther

steps.subject: land
steps.action: lay a small peninsula of brown land
steps.load: small roll of brown on the knife edge
steps.motion: lay a small roll along the bottom
steps.where: bottom of the canvas, small peninsula

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy tufts along the land
steps.load: darker sap green tapped to a ridge

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin dead stems in the background
steps.load: brown and white thinned with thinner
steps.rule: stems create the illusion of depth and distance

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: pick up dark and light paint for stones
steps.load: dark on both sides, light on one side
steps.rule: thinned paint sticks to thick paint

steps.subject: water
steps.action: paint a few ripples across the water
steps.load: same brush with blue, white and clear

steps.subject: water
steps.action: wipe back some color to keep the water see-through
steps.load: wiped nearly clean
steps.rule: keeps the water transparent so rocks show

steps.subject: water
steps.action: brush clear and black gesso over the water
steps.load: clear mixed with black gesso

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: define the rock edge with a small knife
steps.load: small roll of mixed white, black and brown
steps.rule: defining the edge makes it stand out

rules: [12:29] thin paint sticks to thick paint, so add thinner when it will not stick
